summary: More Ansible 11.2 community.general deprecations: the purestorage doc fragments, the sensu_check, sensu_client, sensu_handler, sensu_silence and sensu_subscription modules (use the sensu.sensu_go collection), the slack prepend_hash default changing from auto to never, and the yaml callback in favour of result_format=yaml in the default callback.
questions: What replaces the community.general yaml callback?
Which collection replaces the sensu modules in community.general?
How do I get YAML output without the yaml callback?

answer_card.title: Replace the deprecated yaml callback
answer_card.answer_md:
The `community.general.yaml` callback is deprecated. Use the built-in default callback with YAML output instead, for example in `ansible.cfg`:

```ini
[defaults]
stdout_callback = ansible.builtin.default
callback_result_format = yaml
```
